title: Exam weeks
description: Plan the school's exam periods: the exam timetable, the rooms each exam sits in, who sits where and who invigilates. Students, parents and invigilating teachers see a period in the app once you publish it.

periods.heading: Exam periods
periods.caption: The year's exam periods
periods.help: An exam period is a run of exam days, such as the first term finals, for the grades it covers.
periods.empty: No exam periods this year yet.
periods.deleteDescription: Its timetable, seating and invigilators are deleted with it.
periods.deleteFailed: The exam period could not be deleted.
periods.datesInvalid: The last day must be on or after the first day.

detail.publishFailed: The exam period could not be updated.
detail.draftHelp: Draft: only school leadership sees this timetable. Publish it when it is ready.
detail.publishedHelp: Published: students and parents see their exams with room and seat, and teachers their invigilation duties.
